Second early open-source pre-release with important security improvements.

### Security changes

- Required shared-secret authentication for booking/admin endpoints via
  `ADMIN_API_KEY` and Jotform intake via `JOTFORM_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`.
- Telegram webhook secret is mandatory and incoming chat ID is checked against
  `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`.
- OCR remote image downloads are HTTPS-only with hostname allowlisting,
  redirect validation, streaming size caps, and image pixel limits.
- Diagnostic error handling no longer saves raw malformed Jotform webhook
  payloads; Beds24 debug samples and some booking/document URL logs are redacted.
- SQLite foreign keys enabled for each database connection; guest field update
  keys restricted to a known set.

### Maintenance improvements

- Expanded offline synthetic regression tests and continuous integration.
- Private-configuration preflight checker and read-only aggregate usage metrics.
- Secure deployment migration guide, contribution templates, and prepared
  application wording for the Codex for Open Source program.

### IMPORTANT — existing installation migration

**Do not switch a live deployment to this release without configuring the new
secrets, updating API clients, and coordinating Jotform/Telegram webhook settings.**
When required credentials are missing, secured routes deliberately return 503.
Read [the migration guide](https://github.com/ass3mble/guest-checkin-automation/blob/v0.2.0/docs/SECURE_DEPLOYMENT.md).

This is a **pre-release, not a complete external security audit**. Integration
tests with real third-party accounts, role-level permissions, full PII retention
policies, network egress controls and disaster recovery remain operator tasks.
